# MiniMax Bot upstream snapshot

`minimax-bot/` is copied unchanged from [MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Code-MiniApps](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Code-MiniApps/tree/0f2183f14dd8b8ebffcd08ba42ad719a53a5f5b8/plugins/minimax-ai/minimax-bot) at commit `0f2183f14dd8b8ebffcd08ba42ad719a53a5f5b8`, plugin version 0.7.18. Its MIT license and copyright notice remain in `minimax-bot/LICENSE`; test dependencies are defined in its own lockfile.

This source snapshot is not yet wired into the Android runtime. DSH and MiniMax Code use different host protocols; the MiniMax Code host and its Mini App / MCP integration still need to be installed and tested on the device.
